claims.claim: The public early-access repository, release assets, and installation claims align with current host contracts and exact generated artifacts without asserting unproved host activation.
claims.contract_artifact: Current official OpenAI and Anthropic Agent Skills and plugin documentation plus the public product contract at the exact release revision
claims.implementation_artifact: Public repository/default-branch state, release tag and assets, install provenance, README, INSTALL.md, and PRODUCT-CONTRACT.md
claims.comparison_method: Compare repository, release, artifact, host-surface, prerequisite, support-state, and limitation claims field by field against official contracts and exact generated identities

claims.claim: A fresh Codex context discovers and invokes the exact released standalone runtime package.
claims.execution_target: Fresh Codex context in a clean project that does not contain the Strategic Advisor source repository
claims.source_artifact: Released standalone Strategic Advisor archive and its recorded package, archive, and operative SKILL identities
claims.observation_method: Install the released package at a documented Codex scope, invoke it on a synthetic canary, and retain host/model/version, archive and source identities, invocation, visible source-access trace, loaded references, and output

claims.claim: A clean checkout of the exact release commit reproduces the deterministic install artifacts and rejects package drift and evaluation leakage.
claims.contract_artifact: Committed canonical runtime allowlist, install-artifact schema, independent verifier contract, and positive/negative repository validation contract
claims.implementation_artifact: Clean-checkout archives, provenance, independent verification, full validation output, and successful CI result for the exact release commit
claims.comparison_method: Build twice, compare byte identities, independently verify both triples, run all positive and negative checks, and match the successful CI checkout SHA
